Incident Type: VESSEL

Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: US ARMY GARRISON FORT BELVOIR
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 38.706148, -77.159151 (Approximated from ZIP)
Reported Spill Volume: 0.25 gallon
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** TWO BOATS DOCKED IN THE WATER AT THE DOGUE CREEK MARINA ON FORT BELVOIR WERE DISCOVERED SUNK TODAY SOMETIME BEFORE NOON 16FEB14. THE IRT (FORT BELVOIR FIRE DEPARTMENT) ACTIVATED THE SPCC PLAN AND RESPONDED. THEY FOUND TWO BOATS SUNK IN THE WATER. VERY LITTLE DIESEL PRODUCT WAS NOTICE. THE IOSC ESTIMATED LESS THAN A QT. OF DIESEL JUST INSIDE THE BOAT FLOATING. THE IRT DEPLOYED ADSORBENT BOOMS TO SURROUND THE BOATS. NO PRODUCTS WAS OBSERVED OUTSIDE THESE BOOMS. MARINA OFFICIALS RESPONDED AND ARE IN PROCESS OF PUMPING OUT THE BOATS TO REFLOAT THEM BOTH. THESE BOATS ARE NOT US GOVERNMENT PROPERTY, BUT BELONG TO INDIVIDUALS UNDER CONTRACT WITH FORT BELVOIR TO DOCK THE CRAFT HERE.

THE AIRCRAFT WAS THEN DIVERTED TO JFK AIRPORT IN NEW YORK. CALLER STATES THE FUEL DUMP TOOK PLACE FOR SAFETY PRECAUTIONS IN ORDER TO AVOID AN OVERRATE LANDING AT JFK AIRPORT. CALLER WAS FIRST NOTIFIED OF THIS INCIDENT AT 2112 EST.

THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE ANOMALY APPEARED DARK AGAINST THE OCEAN BACKGROUND AND EXHIBITED A SHIMMERY/SILVERY APPEARANCE, INDICATIVE OF RELATIVELY THICKER OIL. SOME FEATHERING WAS OBSERVED TOWARD THE NORTHWESTERN SECTION. THE ANOMALY MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 4.47 NM IN LENGTH AND 0.50 NM AT ITS WIDEST POINT. UNCERTAINTIES: A DEFINITIVE POINT SOURCE COULD NOT BE IDENTIFIED, AS MULTIPLE OIL WELLS WERE LOCATED TO THE WEST, NORTHWEST, AND NORTH OF THE ANOMALY. ADDITIONALLY, THE ANOMALY WAS LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 7.50 NM SOUTHEAST OF THE ANOMALY REPORTED IN NOAA/NESDIS NRC REPORT #1471655 (08/23). HOWEVER, IT WAS UNCERTAIN WHETHER THE TWO ANOMALIES WERE RELATED.
